title: Bounded Contribution of LLM-Derived Aspect Descriptors to Customer Re-Engagement Timing: An Equivalence Analysis
description: This deposit contains (1) the full pipeline code implementing episodic cohort construction, behavioural Cox proportional-hazards baseline, bootstrap equivalence tests (TOST), and semantic-descriptor ablations reported in the accompanying paper; and (2) the LLM-derived aspect annotation file mass_results_v224_qa.jsonl comprising 2,067 successfully parsed annotation records produced by the Gemini-based ABSA pipeline (prompt version v2.2.4, taxonomy v2.2.4). The annotation file covers Amazon CDs & Vinyl reviews and constitutes the semantic feature input for the survival-analysis models evaluated in the paper.
